stdlibSource.policy: Documentation and examples are verified against the stable Zig 0.16.0 standard library source. Use the expected source path when available; use the override only to point local development at another Zig 0.16.0 stdlib tree.

upgradePolicy: Future Zig target version changes require an explicit upgrade ticket before docs, examples, search behavior, diagnostics, or source-query behavior are retargeted.
